text: NO ONE has ever satisfactorily explained how a single-decker Welsh bus could have gotten itself into orbit. Shooting up over the pass a bit too carefree, and becoming airborne? Caught by a sudden gust of wind? A combination of the two? No one seems to know. But the fact remains that it did.
